activation_checks: Identify actual device manufacturer/model/asset and acquisition host OS
Select official API/driver or documented export path
Map actual measured quantities, units, scale, offset and conditioning
Verify full-chain bandwidth, sampling and anti-alias filtering
Supply calibration records and uncertainty appropriate to the experiment
Verify clocks, triggers and alignment where required
Test capture, disconnect, overload, stop, save and reload
Verify raw evidence preservation and derivative lineage
Review scientific run provenance and physical acceptance before live readiness
next_step: Continue software-only preparation. When external equipment work is authorized, select an actual model and implement its adapter. No assumed device, calibration, bandwidth or biological response.
